answer: Watch where rewards land, not where they come from. A farm exists to pull many payouts into one harbor, so charge a fee that rises with how many distinct earning identities pay one destination in a season: the first pays nothing, the fiftieth loses most of its haul (curve assumed). Exchanges give each user a unique deposit address, so honest cash-outs stay clean. Evasion: never merge and spend each identity alone, stranding the loot like an oasis nobody can reach. Wrongly hit: shared tip jars or a family opal fund, so those register once for a flat cap.
